comment: Public OpenPGP keys of the ACTIVE Node.js releasers, copied verbatim from the repository below at the commit below (its README's 'Active releasers keys' list). packaging/host/build/node-signature.ts imports only these files into a throwaway GnuPG home and accepts nodejs.org's SHASUMS256.txt.sig only from a key whose primary fingerprint is listed here. When Node adds a releaser (a build then fails: 'not a pinned Node.js release key'), copy their keys/<FPR>.asc from the new commit, add the fingerprint, and bump the commit.
